summary: Phase-5 smoke test PASSED. Backend: 52/52 pytest tests green covering health, auth (admin + 5 personas), unauthorized-access guards, all 7 dashboard endpoints x 3 periods, tenants, IRIS Copilot status+chat, AI insights, PPTX export (valid ZIP/PK header), and CSV upload across qradar/xsoar/threat_intel sources. Frontend (Playwright, admin login + all 6 quick-persona buttons + protected route redirects): 21/21 checks passed. Executive Overview renders with populated KPIs (SLA 97.9%, MTTR 60.7h, 56 advisories), AI recommendations, and charts. No 500s, no page errors, no MongoDB _id leaks.

issues: Recharts emits repeated 'width(-1)/height(-1)' console warnings during initial render — cosmetic, charts still display correctly. Consider setting minWidth=0 / aspect prop on ResponsiveContainer wrappers.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 337-339: /dashboard/soc-manager and /dashboard/soar-automation return {data_status:'empty', upload:null} until an XSOAR CSV is uploaded. This is intentional but frontend should handle the empty-state gracefully (verified: pages render without JS errors).
IRIS Copilot chat correctly falls back to source='rule' when HF SmolLM2 model cannot be loaded (disk-limited env) — expected per PS and confirmed working.
PPTX export produces a valid, >5KB .pptx (ZIP PK header) — export endpoint healthy.
test_credentials: Admin admin@mssp-soc.io/Admin@2026! and 5 personas from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all validated working.
seed_data_creation: None. Threat-intel tenant='all' currently shows summary.total_advisories=0 for admin default view (Welspun upload from iteration_6 not present after this session's DB state). Not a blocker for smoke test — endpoint returns 200 with valid empty-state payload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend/frontend both healthy against https://mssp-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. Use /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py + test_smoke_phase5.py as regression (52 tests, ~40s).
